query:
SELECT b.character_id AS "character_id!", b.binding_id AS "binding_id!"
              FROM actor_world_bindings b
              INNER JOIN characters c ON c.character_id = b.character_id
              WHERE b.world_id = ?
                AND b.status = 'active'
                AND c.owner_creator_id = ?
                AND c.status = 'active'
